newsitem.title: USA: GTE awarded $60 million Saudi ARAMCO contracts.
newsitem.headline: GTE awarded $60 million Saudi ARAMCO contracts.

text.p: GTE said Thursday it won two contracts worth more than $60 million from Saudi ARAMCO to provide a communications system for Saudi Arabia's Shaybah oil field.
The company said the system, to be completed in 1998, will help Saudi Arabia to improve its oil production operations.
It said the oil field communications project will include a fiber-optic network, a radio network and a telephone system.
Work on the project will be done by GTE Telecom Saudi Arabia with Dubaib & Sulaim Co. as its partner, it said.

The company said the first contract is for site construction and installation of telecommunications equipment, while the second is for the engineering and design of the system as well as procurement of materials and equipment.
